item.title: Polish unity on show as thousands join silent march for Krakow shooting victims
item.description: Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by Saturday's attack, writes Sarah Rainsford.

item.title: 'They will kill you too': Sonia Gandhi's turbulent journey in Indian politics
